name: video-diorama
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:

· MEDIUM: a still grabbed from an early-2000s standard-definition video tape. Low resolution, soft focus, visible interlacing combs on edges, heavy JPEG/MPEG compression blocks in flat areas, chroma smearing on saturated colour.
· SET: a claustrophobic hand-built diorama where the floor AND the walls are made of one repeated mass-produced object stacked in their hundreds, filling every part of the frame.
· SUBJECT: doll-like and uncanny — oversized features, matte synthetic skin, glossy saturated costume.
· LIGHTING: flat frontal video light, no atmosphere, no cast shadows, slightly blown on the nearest surfaces.
· COLOUR: loud saturated primaries, red dominant, colours bleeding past their edges.
· CROP: 4:3 feel, subject centred and looming towards the lens from slightly above.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
